name: Rekai's Umitober 2023 Compilation: VN Edition
source: Welcome to Rokkenjima, the Witch of Words extends her regards. Please, make yourself at home. Let us enjoy this beautiful night together, shall we? This old Witch has prepared many different tales for us to discuss, stories made only for your eyes. Under this blue glass moon, let us read until our eyes fall off.
